node-forge RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification accepts extra nested DigestAlgorithm elements

note: Counts include transitive propagation, not distinct vulnerabilities. npm 12.2.0 reports 33 high, zero moderate and two root advisories after the UUID fix. Earlier npm 11.9 reported 21 high/7 moderate; raw propagation counts across tool versions are not comparable. The node-forge local patch mitigates the cited RSA DigestInfo issue in installed source while preserving the original registry version and audit finding; its local status is mitigated_by_pinned_backport_pending_upstream_release_and_release_review. Both node-forge and braces installed sources now have pinned checksum-guarded local mitigations. Their original registry versions and advisories remain visible; release approval remains blocked pending upstream release and security review. No advisory filter, forced Expo downgrade, graph-validation waiver or release approval was applied.
